name: Jozibiah
title: Simeonite clan leader
summary: Jozibiah was a leader from the tribe of Simeon, mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of a genealogy of Simeonite leaders. He belonged to a clan that grew and sought new grazing lands during the time of King Hezekiah. His descendants were among those who drove out the Hamites and Amalekites to find pasture for their flocks.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Jozibiah is mentioned as the son of Seraja in the genealogical record of the tribe of Simeon, as one of the prominent leaders of the tribe.

keyEvents.title: Growth of the Simeonites
keyEvents.description: The clans of Simeonite leaders, including Jozibiah's descendants, experienced great growth and became numerous enough to seek new territories.

keyEvents.title: Expansion into the Valley of Gedor
keyEvents.description: Jozibiah's descendants and other Simeonite families went to the entrance of Gedor to seek pasture for their small livestock and found lush and good grazing lands.

keyEvents.title: Expulsion of the Hamites
keyEvents.description: In the days of King Hezekiah, the Simeonites, including the descendants of Joshibiah, came and struck down the Hamites who lived there, completely destroying them, and settled in their place.

keyEvents.title: Victory over the Amalekites at Mount Se'ir
keyEvents.description: Five hundred men from the tribe of Simeon went to Mount Se'ir and struck down the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and they settled there.
